source_semantics.local_finetune_contract: README and code require/recommend per-tool train/validation/test separation; warns that fewer than 120 examples/tool risks overfit; deterministic split seed 42 exists.
source_semantics.tool_call_representation: JSON tool schema input; generated answer is tool name plus arguments; exact source includes constrained decoder, retrieval head, dataset synthesis, finetune, evaluation, local playground and TPU/distributed utilities.

current_frank_mapping.contract_status: Needle is the sole intentional non-Clay semantic foreign body; retained as fast pre-model classifier/router; output bridged into Clay as typed provenance-bound observation/proposal; Needle never mints execution authority.
current_frank_mapping.non_reuse_rule: Historical Needle model/training choices do not redefine the current FRANK authority architecture and do not become a second semantic architecture. Current Needle outputs remain proposals/observations only.

negative_and_security_findings.finding: When constrained decoding finds no valid token, source logs a warning and falls back to unconstrained logits. Argument values are explicitly unconstrained by the name/key trie. Therefore Needle output cannot be treated as an authority or fail-closed validator.
negative_and_security_findings.current_requirement: Deterministic Clay/runtime authority/effect validation must reject invalid or out-of-contract proposals regardless of Needle fallback behavior.

negative_and_security_findings.finding: Checkpoint loading uses Python pickle.load; local UI permits model checkpoint upload and then loads it. Localhost/origin restrictions reduce remote exposure but pickle is unsafe for untrusted checkpoint artifacts.
negative_and_security_findings.current_requirement: Only load trusted hash/signature-verified legacy pickle checkpoints or migrate to a non-code-executing weight format for untrusted/imported artifacts.

negative_and_security_findings.finding: Drive archive is a shallow Git snapshot. Parent commit is named but absent from pack; older upstream history is not present in this source and must not receive archive-completion credit.

Dataset generator can synthesize function-call data via Gemini. Generated examples are synthetic evidence and cannot become sensor truth, execution authority, or final training data without separate provenance/admission policy.

positive_safety_findings: Finetune status/download/model upload and finetune endpoints enforce localhost checks.
Cross-origin POST Origin checks are present.
Checkpoint download path is constrained to checkpoint directory.
Finetune subprocess includes a finite timeout.
